text_markup: Any position protecting a server that is not occupied by a piece of ice ceases to exist, except if it is the Runner's current position or if there is a piece of ice in the process of being installed protecting that server. See also {ref:rule_destroy_position}.
text_plain: Any position protecting a server that is not occupied by a piece of ice ceases to exist, except if it is the Runner's current position or if there is a piece of ice in the process of being installed protecting that server. See also rule 6.2.4.
